WHO WE ARE

A reliable source of farm & agricultural machinery.

Founded in 1990 in Karachi, Alico International has proudly served as the main dealer for Massey Ferguson tractors under Millat Tractors, delivering MF tractors, genuine spare parts, and reliable after-sales service and repairs.

With over 35 years of expertise, we have grown into a comprehensive provider of precision metal fabrication — employing advanced machinery such as HD plasma cutting, laser cutting, saw cutting, hydraulic press brakes, rolling, welding, grinding, painting, assembly and packing.

Our expert team utilizes AutoCAD and SolidWorks to design and manufacture high-performance equipment and custom metal components for industries nationwide, combining innovation, quality and efficient logistics to support both agricultural and industrial needs.

OUR MISSION

Innovation on the ground, not just on paper.

We exist to give farmers and agri-businesses machinery that improves efficiency and productivity in the field — built through genuine research, tested infrastructure, and a commitment to the growth of Pakistan's agricultural sector.

01 — INFRASTRUCTURE

Built to scale

Well-equipped with the manpower, machinery and supply chain to handle large-scale production and delivery — from single units to bulk export orders.

02 — R&D

Research-led design

A research and development-focused company based in Lahore, we emphasize innovation and product quality to drive agricultural growth.

03 — PRODUCT RANGE

One source, full range

Tractors, implements and OEM parts under one roof — a comprehensive line built to cover the needs of modern farming operations.

04 — IMPACT

Growth for agriculture

By providing high-quality, innovative machinery, we aim to contribute to the overall growth of the agricultural sector, particularly in Pakistan.

HOW WE BUILD

In-house, from raw material to finished machine.

Complete in-house facility

Machining and fabrication is carried out on-site in Raiwind, Lahore — metal and casting parts are machined precisely rather than outsourced.

Fiber laser metal cutting

Our latest fiber laser cutting equipment ensures precise, complex parts cutting for tighter tolerances and cleaner finishes.

Research & development focus

An R&D-driven approach lets us refine machinery around the actual needs of modern farming, not just replicate existing designs.

Quality-conscious sourcing

We pay full attention to the quality of products and equipment offered, using industrial-grade raw materials throughout.
